items.summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is accused of bribery, fraud and breach of trust in a long-running trial that has divided the country. He denies all wrongdoing.

items.summary: A Manhattan judge handed a victory to Mayor Zohran Mamdani by dismissing a lawsuit filed by landlords over a rent freeze for rent-stabilized apartments.

items.title: Review: Nvidia U-Turn Is Bad News For Anthropic, Says Parmy Olson

(Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Review: Oil Flows in Hormuz Strait 'Forever Altered,' Says Tom Kloza
items.summary: Tom Kloza, chief energy advisor to Gulf Oil, said that he expects a 'major head fake' from the oil market as the 'seeds' for the next oil rally have been planted and could take gas and diesel prices back up in the beginning of 2027. Kloza also discussed the continued impact that war with Iran has had on the oil market, and said that his view remains that oil flows in the Strait of Hormuz are 'forever altered' by the conflict. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Review: M&A in the Industrials Sector Looks Set for a Robust 2027
items.summary: Industrial M&A activity is set to remain strong in 2027, driven by a clutch of rapidly growing sectors in the space.
